subsystem.instructions: Which emulator subsystem most likely produced this frame divergence?

criteria.ppu_fetcher: pixels shifted or wrong within a line during mode 3
criteria.stat_irq: a raster split lands on the wrong line
criteria.window: window position or line counter wrong

mid_line.instructions: Does the divergence start mid-scanline rather than at x = 0?

criteria.true: the first differing pixel on a line is not at x = 0

emulator_part.instructions: Which part of the emulator most likely caused the pixels that differ from the hardware reference?

criteria.ppu_fetcher: pixels misplaced or wrong inside one line while it is drawn
criteria.stat_irq: a mid-frame split happens on the wrong line
criteria.oam_dma: objects absent or out of date
criteria.window: window placed wrong or its line count off
criteria.timer: state that depends on timing is off

severity.instructions: How severe is this divergence for a player of the game?
criteria: cosmetic: a few pixels differ, play unaffected
visible: a region or band of the frame is wrong
severe: most of the frame is wrong or game state is broken

applies:SKL-0002.instructions: Does skill SKL-0002 apply to this incident: would a repairer fixing it touch what the skill covers?

criteria.true: fires when: a serial transfer started through SC (0xFF02) completes after the wrong number of cycles and link bytes arrive late; paths: core/index.ts
